label: fail
title: slugify produces repeated and leading/trailing dashes, and drops accented letters
body:
`slugify` in src/format.js has a few problems:

- `slugify('  C++ -- The   Good Parts!  ')` returns `c----the-good-parts` — repeated dashes should collapse to one: `c-the-good-parts`.
- `slugify('-Hello-')` should not start or end with a dash: `hello`.
- Accented letters are removed instead of transliterated: `slugify('Café Society')` gives `caf-society`, expected `cafe-society`.

Please fix it and add tests for these cases.
plan:
